title: Projection-normalized cyclic quotient of the integral Tate line
statement: Let l be prime, X a Noetherian scheme with l invertible, and n natural. Let e be any unit-normalized finite realization of the condensed ring ZMod(l^(n+1)) as ordinary modules over ULift(ZMod(l^(n+1))) [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization]. Supply an IntegralRoots for the bottom field and a kernel-normalized FiniteRoots at exponent l^(n+1) [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams]. The ordinary tensor quotient cyclicLine has an e.LineEndpoint with the ordinary cyclic Cartier line [def-diagonal-cyclic-cartier-frame]. Its underlying root map is integralRoots.hom followed by cyclicLineMap; its finite root map is the n-th root-limit projection followed by finiteRoots.toLine. There is no diagonal class, completed arrow, trace or uniformizer in this statement.

proof.text: Use the proved bottom integer-ring identification and the PadicInt.toZModPow annihilation equation to factor the actual condensed cyclic map through the bottom ell-power quotient. Restrict the integral projection and apply the generic scalar-extension/free-projection helper. Its scalar unit equation is exactly the actual root-projection normalization.

The root tower projection is locally surjective, hence the free root projection q is epic. On the common compatible-root cover, the integral basis restricts to Z_l along the bottom coefficient isomorphism and extends to the cyclic ring. The finite root basis gives a rank-one target because the cyclic coefficient is annihilated by l^(n+1). The generic local rank-one theorem gives invertibility on this cover; reflect and descend to obtain IsIso q.

Apply the generic endpointFromFree theorem with q, the given finite realization and finite roots. Its unit normalization composed with q is the required root normalization. No completed diagonal arrow is used.

theorem diagonalCyclicRootEndpoint
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) (n : ℕ)
    (e : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (ZMod (l ^ (n + 1))))
      (diagonalResidue.{u} l n) X)
    (integralRoots : IntegralRoots l (bottomField l) X)
    (finiteRoots : FiniteRoots X (l ^ (n + 1))) :
    Nonempty (e.LineEndpoint (cyclicLine l n X)
      (geoCartierLine (diagonalResidue.{u} l n) (l ^ (n + 1))
        (cartierResidue_cast l (n + 1)) X)
      (integralRoots.hom ≫ cyclicLineMap l n X)
      (limit.π (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower X l (Fact.out : l.Prime)) (op n) ≫
        finiteRoots.toLine (diagonalResidue.{u} l n) (cartierResidue_cast l (n + 1))))
